title: Koi to Senkyo to Chocolate: Koi Imouto!
justification: AniList 18045 (SPECIAL, 1 episode(s) from 2013-03-27) is AniDB 8820's special(s) S1, aired 2013-03-27. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 12175, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 8820, and the special's title matches an AniList title. On TMDB 46093 the parent's node places the special(s) where TMDB's dates disagree (AniDB S1 aired 2013-03-27, TMDB 46093 S0E1 2012-09-26), so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
